t-display.purpose: Entity-panel page titles only (e.g. a ministry's name).

t-title.purpose: The home panel's single headline sentence.

t-head.purpose: Card section headings inside the rail.

t-body.purpose: Base document size: descriptions, news summaries, prose.

t-small.purpose: Secondary paragraph copy, captions, source notes.

t-ui.purpose: Interactive labels: buttons, rows, tabs, inputs.

t-label.purpose: Uppercase section eyebrows; structural only, never emphasis.

wheel-arc-label.purpose: Sector names set on curved textPath arcs around the wheel's rim.

wheel-ring-label.purpose: Tier captions (Cabinet, Ministries...) along the executive wedge.

wheel-anchor.purpose: Upright landmark seat names drawn over the map, paper-stroked for legibility.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every Card, the Chrome bar, and segmented-control pills. In dark mode this becomes a one-pixel top highlight instead of a cast shadow.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Floating chrome that leaves the surface: Search modal, government switcher, Legend popover, hover tooltips, zoom control.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and panel/card transitions (the survey-reveal clip, entity panel swap, dropdown open).

motion.name: ease-std
motion.purpose: Default easing for state/opacity transitions (wheel-node hover, landmark-label fade).

motion.name: wheel-turn-spring
motion.value: type: spring, stiffness 58, damping 17, mass 1, restDelta 0.08
motion.purpose: Turns the whole wheel so a selected seat rests at 6 o'clock; the build's signature ~700ms memorable moment. Falls back to an instant jump under prefers-reduced-motion or on first paint of a deep link.

motion.name: survey-reveal
motion.value: circle clip-path radius: seal → extent+40, duration 0.95s, ease-out
motion.purpose: First sight of any government: the wheel is surveyed outward from the People rather than appearing all at once.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: The live-status dot's pulse; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width call to action, e.g. "Open the [X] government" on a linked State node.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Open the Ministry of Railways government</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:40px; width:100%; padding:0 20px; background:var(--ink-1,#1c1a16); color:var(--card,#fbf9f5); border:none; border-radius:12px; font-size:14px; font-weight:520; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity:0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#1c1a16); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:6px; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Graph / Power map / States view switch, and the entity panel's Connections/Members/News/Budget tabs. A spring-animated pill marks the active choice.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:0; background:var(--well,#e3dfd5); border-radius:12px; padding:4px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(40 30 15 / 0.05); } .ds-tab { height:32px; padding:0 16px; border:none; background:transparent; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; font-weight:520; color:var(--ink-3,#5b554c); cursor:pointer; transition:color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color:var(--ink-1,#1c1a16); } .ds-tab-active, .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background:var(--card,#fbf9f5); color:var(--ink-1,#1c1a16); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(40 30 15 / 0.05); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#1c1a16); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search Trigger
components.description: Opens the full-screen command-palette search (⌘K or /). Floats top-left over the map.
components.css: .ds-search-trigger { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:0 12px; background:var(--card,#fbf9f5); color:var(--ink-3,#5b554c); border:none; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(40 30 15 / 0.05); font-size:14px; font-weight:520; cursor:pointer; } .ds-search-trigger:hover { background:var(--card-2,#f5f2ec); color:var(--ink-1,#1c1a16); } .ds-kbd { margin-left:8px; border:1px solid var(--rule,#e2ddd3); border-radius:4px; padding:0 6px; font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-4,#6f685d); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base rail surface: home panel, entity panel, news, changes, budget sections all compose from this.
components.html:
Latest changes

Appointments, elections and departures, as they are recorded against official sources.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--card,#fbf9f5); border-radius:14px; padding:20px 16px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(40 30 15 / 0.05); } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:17px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.2; letter-spacing:-0.005em; color:var(--ink-1,#1c1a16); } .ds-card-body { margin:0; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.4; color:var(--ink-3,#5b554c); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Borderless field on a slightly-recessed card-2 fill; used for the government switcher and member search.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Find a state or UT" />
components.css: .ds-input { height:36px; width:100%; padding:0 12px; background:var(--card-2,#f5f2ec); border:none; border-radius:12px; font-size:14px; font-weight:520; color:var(--ink-1,#1c1a16); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-4,#6f685d); opacity:1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus,#1c1a16); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Party Chip
components.description: The only chrome element permitted to carry party colour: a dot in the holder's party ink plus the party name.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; background:var(--card-2,#f5f2ec); color:var(--ink-2,#3b3731); border-radius:6px; padding:2px 6px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; } .ds-chip-dot { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#ff9933; }

components.name: Sector Badge
components.description: Change-log kind tag (Elected / Appointed / Acting / Left office), tinted 12% into transparency from the sector ink.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; border-radius:4px; padding:2px 6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--navy,#34419a); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--navy,#34419a) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Seat Glyph States
components.description: Signature map primitive: the same office glyph in its four seat states (held, acting, vacant, unverified) — state is always a stroke/fill pattern, never colour alone.

narrative.overview:
Sarkar Graph draws the Government of India as one wheel, surveyed outward from the People at its centre. The THESIS the build carries out literally: a 24-spoke Ashoka Chakra sits at the hub as the People; every seat of power is placed by its distance from that hub; every wedge is a branch of the state (Parliament, the executive, the judiciary, independent bodies, States & UTs), rendered as territory on a khadi-paper sheet with the stepped, sourced authority of a Survey of India map rather than the boxes-and-lines of an org chart. First contact with any government is literal survey: a circular reveal grows from the seal outward over ~950ms before a single mark is legible. Flag colour is rationed to hairlines, washes and marks — saffron never decorates, it only ever means the People, "elects," or the live chain of authority currently being traced.

The system refuses two things by construction: the org-chart tree (there are no boxes-and-arrows; everything is polar, placed by angle and radius) and the card dashboard (the map is the primary surface; the left rail is commentary on what the map already shows). It also refuses ornament as camouflage — the "clean without any noticeable AI slop" brand commitment lands as flat inks, no gradients, no drop shadows outside a small, deliberate set of floating-chrome elevations, and a fixed glyph alphabet where every institution kind gets exactly one silhouette, never a stock icon.
keyCharacteristics: A living radial instrument, not a poster: click any seat and the whole wheel spring-turns it to 6 o'clock, then draws its chain of authority home in saffron.
Two palettes that never touch: sector ink marks territory (which branch of the state), party ink marks incumbency (who currently holds it) — the map is politically neutral by construction.
Zero overlapping marks, enforced by a track-and-pack layout engine and a regression script, not by hand-tuning.
Paper by day, warm near-black by night — the same flat-ink grammar, re-inked rather than dimmed.

rules.name: The Territory, Not State, Rule
rules.body: Sector ink marks which branch of government a body belongs to. It never marks selection, hover, or authority. Those always render in saffron regardless of the selected seat's own sector — a judiciary seat's chain of authority is drawn in saffron, not ochre.

rules.name: The Party Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: A second, disjoint palette (partyInk) exists solely for incumbency — avatar rings, hemicycle seat-dots, party chips, and the States cartogram's tile fills. It appears only where party affiliation is literally the fact on screen; it never substitutes for or blends with sector ink.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Structure Rule
rules.body: text-transform: uppercase with wide letter-spacing (0.08em–0.24em) marks only wayfinding and structural labels — section eyebrows and wheel labels. Body copy, titles, and button labels are always set in normal case; uppercase never carries emphasis on its own.

rules.name: The Overlap-Free Invariant
rules.body: layout.ts's layoutWheel places every drawn mark on a track sized to its largest occupant, then uses a 1-D least-squares packer to space marks along that track with a guaranteed minimum gap. scripts/check-layout.ts lays out every government in the dataset and fails the build if any pair of marks overlaps or a mark lands inside the seal. Any change to sizing, tiering, or sector allocation must keep check-layout green.

rules.name: The Flat-Map, Lifted-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the wheel itself ever casts a shadow — depth there is opacity and tone only. Shadow is reserved for UI that is temporarily floating above the page; once something is part of the permanent layout it gets shadow-card at most.

rules.name: The Glyph Alphabet Rule
rules.body: Every institution kind has exactly one fixed silhouette, shared across every government and every sector colour. The same shape means the same kind of thing on every wheel; new institution kinds get a new silhouette, never a re-use of an existing one with a different colour.

rules.name: The Seat State Is Never Colour-Only Rule
rules.body: A seat's state (held / acting / vacant / unverified) is always encoded in stroke and fill pattern, on top of and independent of its sector colour. State must be legible in grayscale or under colour-blindness; colour alone never carries it.

dos: Do keep the seven sector inks mapped one-to-one to branch/territory (people, executive, legislative, judicial, constitutional, federal, local) across every government; never reassign one for a single view.
Do give any new seat state or institution kind its own shape or stroke pattern, not just a new colour — see the Glyph Alphabet and Seat State rules.
Do run scripts/check-layout.ts after any change to layout.ts, sizeOf, or the node dataset; a nonzero exit blocks the change.
Do route new panel copy through Card + the t-* role classes rather than ad hoc Tailwind text sizes, so the type ramp stays closed.

Do treat dark mode as a parallel, hand-tuned palette swap via [data-theme="dark"] (including re-balanced sector inks and an inset-highlight shadow), not a filter or opacity trick over the light tokens.
donts: Don't use saffron for anything except the People/root, "elects" edges, the active chain of authority, and live/fresh indicators — its rarity is what makes the chain readable against seven other inks.
Don't apply party colour to anything that isn't literally displaying a party affiliation (no party-tinted chrome, sector wedges, or navigation).
Don't add a box-shadow beyond --shadow-card / --shadow-pop; the map itself never casts a shadow, and only genuinely floating chrome gets shadow-pop.
Don't hard-code a wedge, tier, or mark radius on the map; every size must come from sizeOf() / layoutWheel() so the overlap-free invariant holds.
Don't rotate a glyph or its label with the wheel's turn; only the unrotated structural layers spin — marks and text stay upright via .upright / --wr counter-rotation.
